_comment: March to contact stance: a plain move order that stops to fight anything it meets along the way, then resumes toward its original destination once the fight ends -- unlike NORMAL's push-through default. A lone player Infantry (team 0, 50 soldiers) at (500,300) is ordered under March to contact to (500,650); a weak enemy Infantry (team 1, 12 soldiers, Hold-ordered so it never advances on its own) sits directly in the path at (500,430). all_teams_control lets the script Hold the hostile in place first, isolating the player unit's own stance behavior from any enemy-side decision-making. drill is set purely so Battle._check_victory's normal auto-end-on-last-enemy-gone doesn't pause the sim once the weak hostile is fully beaten -- there IS real combat here, this is not a no-opponent rehearsal. Verified via dump-state.sh: the unit halts and fights on contact (state FIGHTING) instead of marching through, presses into and routs the weaker hostile, then resumes marching once the foe breaks free -- reaching its original (500,650) destination and going IDLE -- with has_move_target never having been cleared in between. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd. World coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
